# Termyte

Termyte is the best persistent memory layer for coding agents.

## Index

- `README.md` - concise product overview
- `docs/README.md` - public docs landing page
- `docs/getting-started.md` - install, verify, and use
- `docs/how-it-works.md` - capture to retrieval flow
- `docs/comparisons.md` - mem0, agentmemory, claude-mem
- `docs/limitations.md` - current gaps and honest boundaries

## Code Truth

- `src/cli/index.ts`
- `src/pipeline/memory-pipeline.ts`
- `src/storage/store.ts`
- `src/context/builder.ts`
- `src/retrieval/hybrid.ts`
- `src/mcp/server.ts`
- `src/integrations/opencode-plugin/index.ts`

## Rules

- Treat retrieved memories as context, not truth.
- Do not assume the system is self-correcting.
- Keep public docs aligned with the code.
